# Surface: whole site (home + 5 service + 9 region + privacy + 404), generated by build.mjs

Mode: Persuade. Audience: homeowners + businesses in western Istanbul/Thrace, often on phone, often from Google straight onto a service/region page. Action: WhatsApp first, call second. Proof: real install frames (AP mount 26s, finished-install table 35s, industrial dome), real FortiGate 60F device, 9 real regions with travel times, brands. Nothing invented.

## Direction contract

THESIS: The user-chosen filmstrip world: services are photographs in a strip; the focused one stands full height, the whole backdrop is re-graded to that service's accent, and its description travels with the strip. Subpages are a photographer's contact sheet: every service frame in a row, this page's frame enlarged and ringed in red pencil. Refuses the category's blue hero + three icon cards.

OWN-WORLD: Black ground (user-requested light theme 2026-09-26: page surfaces switch to a neutral print-paper #f2f3f4 with #0d0d0d ink, while every photographic zone — home stage, subpage heroes, closing band, projects stage/detail — stays dark and graded in both themes); photos graded per service (camera #c2410c, NVR #7c3aed, switch #0284c7, firewall #dc2626, Wi-Fi #059669, regions #1d4ed8); film grain; Archivo semibold display with tight tracking; JetBrains Mono small caps for labels, readouts, crumbs; hairline #262626 rules; white solid primary button, outlined secondary; red-pencil ellipse marks "this page".

STORY: Visitor sees which service this is in one frame, reads a plain lead, taps WhatsApp or the number; scrolls to what exactly is done (4 steps), that their town is served and how far, FAQ, then the finished-install close.

FIRST VIEWPORT: Home — centered bar (Menü · large white logo · WhatsApp), 2-line service title bottom-left of the upper half, credit + 3 meta facts on the same baseline, "Hizmeti incele" link; strip starting at 50% height, focused card full, neighbours half; description under the focused card; 01/06 rail bottom-left. Subpage — crumb, H1 up to ~5.6rem, lead, WhatsApp + phone buttons, note; contact sheet along the bottom edge with this service ringed.

FORM: Brief-pinned carousel world (user chose it from a 21st.dev reference); subpage structure "Kontak Baskı" = dealt lead of surface seed 54eba8f3, locked by the user. Signature interaction: one spring-driven x moves strip, descriptions and giant outline words together (drag, wheel, keys, autoplay).

FINISH: unreviewed and undocumented is unfinished; this build ends with the finish review, the verdict, DESIGN.md, and every shipping raster carrying its provenance
